entry.title: Boundary Plateau Laws II
entry.summary:
Given a straight line $\ell \subset \mathbb R^3$, we classify $2$-dimensional cones in $\mathbb R^3$ which contain $\ell$ and are Almgren minimizing with respect to $\ell$. The main idea of this paper is due to an LLM, and the paper was written by an LLM, under the guidance of the authors.

Source: arXiv Analysis, PDEs & Probability (AP, PR, NA, OC) · Tags: #analysis-pde #probability-stats #algebra-geometry

entry.title: Octonions and the Standard Model (Part 15)
entry.summary:
John Baez, Endre Bokor and Latham Boyle have a new paper which gets at the Standard Model gauge group and its representation on one generation of fermions starting from a Jordan triple that consists of pairs of bioctonions.

Source: The n-Category Café (Math, Physics & Philosophy) · Tags: #algebra-geometry #formal-proofs #high-energy
